items.title: Goldman, Morgan Stanley and Evercore Are Advising on What Could Be the Biggest Deal Ever
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMorgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs are advising SpaceX’s special committee, and Evercore is advising Tesla’s, on a possible all-stock merger of two companies worth about $3. 3 trillion together, the Financial Times reported.

items.title: Bill Ackman Says the Fed Is “About to Make Another Mistake” on Dec. 9
items.summary: Bill Ackman wants the Fed to abandon its 2% inflation goal before a rate decision that markets already expect. His case rests on one startling borrowing cost, and the Fed chair has already shut the door on his idea.

items.title: How SpaceX GPU Financing At Goldman Sachs Has Changed Its Investment Story
items.summary: Goldman Sachs Group has been active in fixed income markets in November 2026, issuing a series of callable senior fixed rate notes across maturities from 2028 to 2046, while also arranging a record US$44b GPU and equipment financing deal for SpaceX that deepens its role in AI infrastructure funding. This mix of long dated bond issuance and large AI related financing highlights how Goldman Sachs Group is pairing balance sheet funding with fee based advisory and lending linked to technology...
